model: Holdco sum-of-parts NAV (HKT stake at market value plus PCCW's own media/other businesses, less PCCW-level net debt and perpetual capital securities)

valuation_philosophy.summary: PCCW is a holding company, not an operating company in its own right. Consolidated group revenue (HK$40,252m FY2025) and EBITDA (HK$13,290m) are ~91% generated by HKT (Hong Kong's dominant integrated telecom operator, separately listed as 6823.HK), of which PCCW owns only 52.22% (3,959,683,681 of 7,582,695,674 HKT Share Stapled Units in issue per HKT's own FY2025 substantial-shareholder disclosure). The remaining ~47.78% of HKT's profit is stripped out through the consolidated income statement as profit attributable to non-controlling interests (HK$2,642m in FY2025, HK$2,007m in FY2024), which is why PCCW's own attributable net income has been NEGATIVE for two straight years (-HK$253m FY2025, -HK$300m FY2024) and PCCW's attributable shareholders' equity is negative and deepening (-HK$1,966m FY2025, -HK$4,207m H1 FY2026) even though the underlying group is growing and HKT itself is solidly profitable and investment-grade rated. Applying an owner-FCF DCF to PCCW's consolidated cash flows would value 100% of HKT's cash flows as if they belonged to PCCW shareholders and would be wrong by roughly double; applying it to PCCW's own attributable net income/FCF is equally wrong in the other direction, because a loss-making, negative-book-value shell with a genuinely valuable, separately-traded majority stake is not a going-concern DCF candidate on its own numbers. Per the dcf-methods skill's routing table (a holdco that also has its own smaller operating businesses = 'value the parts separately and sum'), this DCF is built as a sum-of-parts: (1) PCCW's 52.22% economic interest in HKT valued at HKT's own market price (6823.HK, a liquid, separately-listed security -- using HKT's live quote avoids re-deriving a second, redundant DCF on cash flows this project has not separately researched in full, and lets HKT's own market efficiently price its telecom fundamentals, AI-infrastructure monetisation and passive-network stake-sale proceeds); (2) PCCW's own directly-held Media Business (Viu OTT, ViuTV, MakerVille) and Other Businesses (PCCW Solutions, PCCW Global, corporate), valued at a modest EV given the segment is only just turning EBITDA-positive (HK$36m combined in FY2025, HK$(156)m in FY2024) with credible medium-term upside (Viu OTT EBITDA margin already expanded from 16% to 24% FY2025 / 29% H1 FY2026, management guiding toward 'sustainable profitability'); less (3) PCCW-level (above-HKT) net debt -- HK$13,712m, being PCCW-consolidated net debt of HK$56,330m (total borrowings HK$58,922m less cash HK$2,592m) LESS HKT's own net debt of HK$42,618m (HKT's own FY2025 annual report: total borrowings HK$44,575m less cash HK$1,957m) -- which isolates the leverage carried directly by PCCW/CAS Holding No. 1 Limited on top of its share of HKT's own balance sheet, avoiding double-counting HKT's debt (already netted inside HKT's market cap); and (4) the HK$5,590m of perpetual capital securities issued by CAS Holding No. 1 Limited (a direct wholly-owned PCCW subsidiary, IFRS-classified as equity but economically debt-like: fixed 4% distribution, non-participating, senior to PCCW ordinary shareholders in the capital stack), deducted as a debt-like claim ahead of PCCW ordinary equity. Cross-check: PCCW's own dividend of 38.25 HK cents/share capitalised at a plausible 8-10% cost of equity with 0-2% growth brackets HK$3.82-6.50/share, closer to the current price than the sum-of-parts NAV -- consistent with PCCW historically trading at a persistent discount to look-through NAV that the market appears only partially to price in today (PCCW's market cap is currently ~83% of the GROSS, pre-debt HKT stake value alone, before even deducting PCCW's own ~HK$19.3bn of net debt-like claims). That gap -- between what the market pays for PCCW and what its parts are actually worth once its own leverage is deducted -- is the central finding of this valuation, not a modelling artefact.
key_risks_to_valuation: HKT's own share price (6823.HK) is the single largest driver of PCCW's per-share value here; a move in HKT's quote flows through PCCW's stake value at the 52.22% ratio with no dampening

PCCW-level net debt is a residual calculation (group net debt less HKT's own net debt) rather than a directly disclosed 'parent-only, ex-HKT' figure; the standalone Company-level balance sheet (note 4) shows PCCW-entity-only borrowings of HK$13,571m plus HK$6,826m net owed to subsidiaries, which is broadly consistent with the HK$13,712m residual used here but the two are not identical line items and a future filing could reconcile them differently

The perpetual capital securities are IFRS-equity, not debt; treating them as a debt-like deduction is a judgement call (they have no maturity and PCCW can defer distributions), and a reader who disagrees would add back some or all of the HK$5,590m

Media Business (Viu/ViuTV/MakerVille) valuation of HK$0-2,500m is a judgement-based range, not a market price or a full DCF -- it is ~3-8% of total equity value in the base/bull cases so a wide miss here does not change the overall conclusion much, but it is the least rigorous input in the model

The market currently prices PCCW well above this sum-of-parts NAV (see valuation_philosophy) -- either the market is right that a real, durable holdco discount does not apply as harshly as this model assumes (e.g., because the dividend is well-covered by HKT upstreaming and investors price PCCW as an income security, not a NAV proxy), or PCCW is genuinely overvalued today; this valuation takes the latter view but flags it explicitly as a live disagreement with the tape
Continued passive-network-infrastructure stake sales change PCCW-level net debt and could also crystallise a partial re-rating of HKT's own multiple if AI-infrastructure demand is validated

inputs.shares_outstanding_basis: FY2025 weighted average diluted shares (loss-making basis, so basic = diluted); ~7,747.7m per HKT-style disclosure of options representing 9.9895% of shares in issue cross-check
inputs.hkt_ownership_basis: HKT Trust and HKT Limited FY2025 Annual Report, substantial shareholders table: PCCW/CAS Holding No. 1 Limited holds 3,959,683,681 of 7,582,695,674 total Share Stapled Units in issue (52.22%)
inputs.pccw_level_net_debt_basis: Residual = PCCW consolidated net debt (56,330) less HKT's own net debt (42,618), both at 31-Dec-2025; cross-checked against PCCW's standalone Company-level balance sheet (note 4 of the FY2025 annual report): entity-only long-term borrowings HK$13,571m + net amounts due to subsidiaries HK$6,826m less cash HK$288m, a similar order of magnitude via a different decomposition
inputs.perpetual_capital_securities_basis: FY2025 annual report note 31: US$750m (originally) issued Jan-2021 by CAS Capital No. 1 Limited (PCCW subsidiary), 4.00% p.a., IFRS-classified as equity; HK$5,590m carrying value at FY2025 after a HK$287m partial redemption during the year
inputs.media_other_basis: FY2025 combined Media Business + Other Businesses segment EBITDA HK$36m (vs -HK$156m FY2024); Media Business alone HK$773m EBITDA on HK$3,613m segment revenue, Other Businesses -HK$737m; judgement-based EV given the segment straddles break-even with a credible OTT-margin-expansion path (Viu EBITDA margin 16%->24% FY2025 ->29% H1 FY2026) but no market price and no full standalone DCF built
inputs.units: millions except per-share and price figures
inputs.wacc_rationale: Not applicable in the conventional sense -- this is a sum-of-parts NAV model, not a discounted-flow model. HKT's own equity value is taken directly from HKT's market price rather than re-derived at a WACC; a dividend-capitalisation cross-check (see valuation_philosophy) uses an 8-10% cost of equity range appropriate to a HK large-cap telecom-adjacent income holdco.
inputs.lease_treatment: not applicable -- sum-of-parts NAV model; HKT's own lease liabilities are embedded in HKT's market price, and PCCW's own segments carry immaterial leases
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is handled structurally, not as a deduction from a consolidated flow: PCCW's economic interest in HKT (52.22%) is applied directly to HKT's market capitalisation, so the ~47.78% NCI share of HKT is excluded at the input stage rather than netted out of a P&L line. Viu's own minority (37.3% since the 2023-2024 partial disposals) is not separately modelled -- it sits inside the judgement-based Media Business valuation.
inputs.notes: Model chosen per .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md routing table: 'When a ticker straddles two rows (a REIT with a big operating business, a holdco that also trades), value the parts separately and sum.' PCCW is a holdco (route: BVPS-compounding/NAV family) with a majority-but-not-100% stake in a separately-listed operating company (HKT, 6823.HK) plus its own smaller operating businesses. An owner-FCF DCF was rejected because (a) PCCW's own attributable net income and FCF are structurally negative/near-zero after the NCI and perpetual-distribution charges, so there is no meaningful attributable flow to project and discount, and (b) consolidated group FCF (HK$4,543m FY2025) belongs mostly to HKT's non-controlling unitholders, not to PCCW shareholders, so discounting it whole would overstate PCCW's value by roughly 2x. This is the first valuation of 0008.HK in this project (no prior DCF/Drivers file existed); 6823.HK (HKT) itself has extracted filings but no DCF of its own yet in this project, so HKT's live market price was used for its equity value rather than building a second, separate owner-FCF DCF inside this one.

historical_growth.net_income_attributable_note: Not meaningful -- attributable net income has been negative in 2 of the last 3 years (FY2023 -471, FY2024 -300, FY2025 -253) due to the structural NCI/perpetual-distribution drag; no CAGR is calculable or informative
historical_growth.equity_attributable_note: Not meaningful -- attributable shareholders' equity has been negative since FY2025 (-1,966) and deepening (-4,207 at H1 FY2026); a compounding growth rate on a series that crosses zero and turns negative is undefined
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: consolidated group EBITDA 5yr CAGR, used only as a soft sanity check on HKT's own operating trajectory -- NOT used to project PCCW's own cash flows, since this model does not discount a PCCW flow series
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Consolidated revenue/EBITDA are modestly growing (1-4% CAGR) while attributable net income and attributable equity are both negative and have been for 2-3 years -- this divergence is exactly why a standard owner-FCF/BVPS-compounding model on PCCW's own attributable numbers would be meaningless here; it is the reason for the sum-of-parts route, not a data error.

base.narrative: HKT valued at its last regular-session close (HK$12.25, near the middle of its 52-week range). Media/Other businesses valued at a modest HK$1.2bn given the segment only just turned EBITDA-positive in FY2025 (HK$36m) with a credible but unproven path to real profitability via Viu's margin expansion. PCCW-level net debt and perpetual securities held at their FY2025 disclosed/derived levels.

bull.narrative: HKT re-rates to its 52-week high (AI-infrastructure/data-centre connectivity demand validated, passive-network stake-sale proceeds accelerate deleveraging and are reflected in a stronger HKT quote). Viu achieves the 'sustainable profitability' management is guiding toward and the wider Media Business is credited with a materially higher EV. PCCW-level net debt held flat (deleveraging proceeds are assumed to flow through HKT's own balance sheet/market price rather than reducing PCCW's own net debt further in this scenario).

bear.narrative: HKT trades back to its 52-week low (intensifying HK telecom price competition, a reversal of the currently favourable declining-rate environment pressuring the sector multiple). Media Business/Viu OTT competitive intensity from Netflix/Disney+/iQIYI/WeTV prevents the segment from ever reaching sustainable profitability and it is valued at nil. PCCW-level net debt held flat (no further deleveraging progress).

projections.note: This is a point-in-time sum-of-parts NAV model, not a multi-year discounted-flow projection -- there is no year-by-year revenue/EBITDA/FCF path to discount. The scenario 'assumptions' above ARE the full model: an HKT share price, a Media/Other EV, and two debt-like deductions. Per the dashboard's slider-engine contract, the underlying HKT-segment revenue is carried here for reference only.

entry_price.method: This is a static NAV model, not a multi-year flow projection, so the standard 'PV of interim flows + PV of terminal value at the hurdle rate' formula does not apply directly. Entry price is instead computed as base intrinsic value discounted one hurdle-period (base_IV / 1.15), the simplest defensible margin-of-safety framing for a point-in-time NAV that is not expected to compound at a modelled rate over a multi-year horizon (see owner-fcf.md guidance for non-FCF/NAV models: exit value at the appropriate multiple, hurdle applied as a margin of safety rather than baked into a growth path).

sensitivity.axes: HKT share price (columns) x PCCW-level net debt / deleveraging progress (rows) -- these are the two dominant, independently observable drivers of PCCW's sum-of-parts value; a conventional WACC/terminal-growth grid is not meaningful for a static NAV model
sensitivity.note: Holding Media/Other EV at the base HK$1,200m and perpetual securities at HK$5,590m throughout; each row is +/-15%/+/-7.5% steps around the base PCCW-level net debt of HK$13,712m, each column steps across HKT's 52-week trading range.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear is weighted above the house default 25% because the structural NCI/leverage drag that produces PCCW's negative attributable earnings and equity is a real, multi-year pattern (not a one-off), Hong Kong telecom competition is explicitly flagged as intensifying by management, and the market's current price already implies investors are paying close to HKT's full GROSS stake value for PCCW shares while seemingly discounting PCCW's own ~HK$19.3bn of net-debt-like claims (net debt + perpetuals) -- a gap that could close via PCCW's price falling as plausibly as via a re-rating. Base retains the plurality weight as the most likely 'nothing changes' outcome (HKT trades near its recent range, Media/Other stays modestly EBITDA-positive).
probability_weighted.band_position_note: Not applicable -- there is no house/street SBC-adjustment distinction in a sum-of-parts NAV model; band_position is only meaningful for the owner-FCF component route.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for both 0008.HK and 6823.HK at inputs.price_as_of / inputs.hkt_price_as_of; 6823.HK 52-week range 10.90-13.58
data_sources.financials: 0008.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (segment note 6, consolidated statement of financial position, note 31 perpetual capital securities, note 4 Company-level standalone balance sheet, note 39 borrowings/interest-rate tables) and 6823.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (substantial shareholders table for the 52.22% ownership stake, HKT's own total borrowings and cash) and 0008.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt / 6823.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt for trend corroboration; research/0008.HK/Reports/0008.HK_Metrics.csv

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
